title: Chapter 352 God?
content:
Chapter 352 God?

So, no matter how the middle-aged man in front of him decides, he will go to heaven.

Absolute power, from the moment he appeared, was no longer in his hands.

"I wonder where your master is going?"

The middle-aged man looked at Lu Daosheng and said in a low voice.

Faced with the problem of a middle-aged man, Lu Daosheng's expression remained unchanged, but he just stretched out his hand lightly.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the space began to tremble.

The middle-aged man in the distance was slightly stunned, his expression suddenly became extremely shocked.

Just when he wanted to escape, his body was forcibly fixed.

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly walked to him and pressed his hand on his shoulder.

"lead the way."

Lu Daosheng's voice was very calm, but there was a faint murderous intent hidden.

At this moment, the middle-aged man was completely confused.

He never thought that the man in front of him would have such a powerful method, and he would never have thought that the other party would be so domineering.

But he had no choice.

After all, he is just a job.

......

Somewhere in China.

Through layers of fog, Lu Daosheng and the other two finally cleared away the fog and saw the light of the sky. A very ancient aura came to their faces.

The eyes suddenly became clear, and various stone houses made of rocks stood among the mountains and forests, as if they had entered the primitive world.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng and the other two seemed a little small here.

Above a peak.

The old man in white slowly opened his turbid eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes.

His white hair fluttered in the wind, and his fairy-like appearance stood here like a powerful man who had been hidden in the world for many years.

At this time, a mountain wind blew, hitting his face like a sharp blade.

"Ah cut!"

The old man sneezes and hurriedly hugged his arms and ran towards the bottom of the mountain.

"Is this God?"

Lu Daosheng glanced at the scene in front of him and asked with a little suspicion.

To be honest, he was a little disappointed.

In his opinion, the spiritual energy here is only slightly enriched, barely reaching the point where he can practice.

It is not easy to have such a place in Blue Star.

But for Lu Daosheng, it is much worse.

Seeing the disdain in Lu Daosheng's eyes, the middle-aged man opened his mouth and wanted to refute, but couldn't say anything.

The opponent's strength is far above him, and it is even somewhat beyond his cognition.

He was really unable to refute what Lu Daosheng said.

And at this moment, an old man in white suddenly walked slowly towards here from a distance.

Behind him, several masters with deep auras were seen by the naked eye. The old man in white in front of him had a very high status in this so-called inner world of God.

"Your Excellency, it seems that you are not a local."

When he saw Lu Daosheng from afar, the old man in white said with a smile.

Seeing the old man in white, there was a ripple in Lu Daosheng's calm eyes.

"It seems that this place is not simpler than it seems."

Looking at the old man in white, Lu Daosheng commented.

The two of them looked at each other, and the atmosphere suddenly became much more subtle.

The middle-aged man beside Lu Daosheng and the old man in white behind everyone looked suspicious.

Do the two know each other?

"You are the master of God, right?"

Lu Daosheng continued to ask.

Hearing this, the old man in white shook his head, as if he was mocking himself: "Master? Haha, I don't dare to be it. I am just the caregiver of God."

"Careman?"

Lu Daosheng became interested.

The old man in white nodded, then turned sideways and said politely: "Please."

"After entering God, all your doubts will be resolved."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked back at Jiang Xiaoxiao who was looking at the surrounding environment curiously, and nodded slightly at her.

In this way, the two followed the old man in white and slowly entered the depths of God.

Along the way, the road was rugged, but all three of them were not ordinary people, so there was no big deal.

Soon, a strange cave appeared in front of the three of them.

Shandong is not big, and it just can accommodate three people in a row.

This God is indeed a different world.

As if he noticed Lu Daosheng's thoughts, the old man in white said proudly: "The real God inside."

Immediately, the three of them entered.

The air in the cave was slightly moist and the walls were smooth. A strange aura that seemed to belong to the blue star floated in the cave space, making the cave a little more mysterious.

Lu Daosheng's brows gradually frowned.

Even he had never encountered this aura.

After feeling it a little, Lu Daosheng was surprised to find that this aura was faintly above all the aura he encountered.

In an instant, Lu Daosheng was ecstatic and the breath in his body began to overflow unconsciously.

Feeling the disorder of Lu Daosheng's breath, the old man in white next to him suddenly felt a storm in his heart.

What a strong aura? !

Could it be that this guy just came into contact with God and realized the true meaning of God?

This guy has a future!

At this time, Lu Daosheng had also begun to gradually calm down.

The chaotic aura began to gradually restrain itself.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's eyes were nothing else, only the road that could not be seen clearly in front of him.

I don’t know how long I walked, but I finally stopped being pitch black, but turned into a dazzling light.

Buzz —

At this time, the sound of space trembling sounded.

When the three of them opened their eyes again, the scene in front of them suddenly changed drastically.

There are no more mountains, forests and stone houses, they are just some cover-ups.

The mountains hanging upside down in the void out of thin air, the huge palace with a sacred aura, and the huge sacred trees covering the sky and the sun in the distance are all emitting supreme aura.

Seeing this scene in front of him, Jiang Xiaoxiao beside Lu Daosheng's eyes were blurred and she looked yearning for her.

The old man in white looked proud, "Did you see it? This is God, and it is not an exaggeration to call it a fairyland on earth."

"No, this place can no longer be called the world!"

Whenever he came here, the old man in white always looked excited and danced and wanted to introduce Lu Daosheng here.

At this moment, he didn't notice at all, and Lu Daosheng's face was getting more and more ugly.

Lu Daosheng slowly turned around and looked at the old man in white, and a low voice came out.

"Your strength is obtained from here, right?"

"How much do you know about this?"

These two questions made the old man in white a little stunned.

Before the old man in white could answer, Lu Daosheng slowly moved forward.

Seeing this, the old man in white looked shocked and quickly waved, "No!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already taken a step forward suddenly.

boom!

Suddenly, the whole of God began to shake, and countless cracks in space emerged out of thin air.

Before they could wait, the two of them were shocked.

Lu Daosheng had already punched out again.

The endless fist light rushed forward with unrivaled force.

Rumble!

At this moment, the whole of God was shrouded under that punch.
